description: The 2020 Nigeria Education Data Survey (NEDS) for the Evaluation of Better Education Service Delivery for All (BESDA) Operation is designed to provide information on education for children age 4-16 years.

label: NAIIS 2018
description: The 2018 Nigeria AIDS Indicator and Impact Survey (NAIIS) is a nationally representative household-based survey that provides comprehensive data on HIV prevalence, incidence, and related indicators across Nigeria. The survey tested 95,743 adults aged 15-64 years.
